concepts.name: A — A little thought
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished, high-resolution design presentation board for a proposed STATIC MARKETING WEBSITE for Little Hint, a self-hosted invite-only gift coordination web app for families and friends. This is a website design concept, NOT a redesign of the application. Use the attached approved brand overview as a visual reference for the exact heart-cutout gift tag, logo lettering and colors; do not reproduce the reference board's layout. Preserve the brand name "Little Hint" and tagline "Gift ideas, shared thoughtfully." No new logo.
Board format: landscape 4:3, approximately 2400x1800 or larger. Small restrained concept title in a neutral outside margin at top. Left 72% shows a complete desktop landing page, from its navigation through hero and two substantive feature sections to self-hosting call to action and footer. Right 24% shows a complete narrow mobile responsive version of the same design, aligned at top. Ample gutter. Show flat straight-on webpage canvases; no perspective, laptop hardware, hands, scene backgrounds, or floating decorative widgets. Each page is long enough to demonstrate content beyond the hero. Keep typography legible, use concise copy. Both versions must look intentionally responsive, not shrunken copies.
Shared exact content: navigation brand logo plus "Features", "Self-host", "GitHub"; hero headline "A little thought. A lovely surprise."; hero body "Wish lists, gift ideas, and quiet coordination for your favorite people."; visible descriptor "Self-hosted. Invite-only."; primary CTA "Self-host Little Hint"; secondary CTA "View on GitHub". Feature headlines "Know what they would love.", "Keep the surprise.", and supporting "Give together." A final section "Your circle. Your server." with brief text "Host Little Hint, invite your people, and start sharing ideas." followed by "Read the setup guide". Footer brand and GitHub link. Avoid testimonials, metrics, pricing, customer logos, sales claims, public signup, cloud service buttons, payment processing, encryption claims, AI claims.
App screen concepts must resemble the existing app: warm ivory #fff8f0, paper #fffdf9, dark brown #2b201d, muted brown #746057, sienna #aa4d37, blush #f4e4da, thin warm borders, system sans-serif UI. Desktop app has left sidebar with Little Hint mark and Home, People, My lists, Buying, Exchanges; mobile app uses bottom icon/text navigation. Flat unboxed gift entries, squared-off softly rounded controls, restrained 8-14px corner radii. Illustrative gift titles "A ceramic pour-over set", "A linen-bound journal", "A weekend daypack"; use tasteful simple neutral product silhouettes or labeled empty image placeholders, not invented brand product photos. Recipient names Alex, Sam and Jamie. An example giver screen may show "Available" and "Taken care of"; don't show giver purchase information on recipient's own Surprise list. Feature imagery may show a Buying list or a Secret exchange panel with one assigned recipient only. Include small readable caption "Illustrative app screens" immediately beneath screen group. Application screenshots here are CONCEPTUAL and will be replaced with real captures in final code.
No generic SaaS bento grids, neon, glass, loud gradients, random decorative blobs, stock lifestyle photos, made-up features, illegible filler paragraphs, or excessive rounded cards. Use semantic-looking real headings and clear hierarchy. Production-quality visual concept, cohesive spacing, aligned content, realistic web components.
CONCEPT A: Label board "A / A little thought". Warm editorial, personal and calm. Dominant ivory background, sienna buttons, deep brown body copy, small blush accents. Marketing headings in expressive restrained Fraunces-like serif and supporting clean sans; logo stays approved artwork. Hero is asymmetrical, left-aligned generously scaled headline occupying left half, tall mobile wish-list screen right, a tiny supporting detail crop tucked beside it. No ornamental tag illustrations beyond actual brand. Below hero, an open editorial two-column section "Know what they would love." pairs concise narrative with a horizontal selection of three gift entries. Next a full-width pale blush section "Keep the surprise." pairs a modest buying-coordination panel with explanation. Small supporting line "Give together. Track contributions without moving money." Close with sienna call-to-action section with ivory text and restrained outlined button. Use intentional generous whitespace and subtle horizontal rules, no boxed feature grids. Mobile stacks hero text then app screen then feature sections.
